selection: first5 frozen UID order; no quality/timing selection
time_scope: synchronized wall time of native generation incl CLIP/VAE, geometry transfer/encoding and PIL conversion; excluding source IO/model load/normal-depth CPU input conversion/PNG writing/metric scoring; CPU and GPU shared host concurrency reported
quality: frozen50-object scores; benchmark outputs must match exact pixel hashes
inference: descriptive per-GPU medians and object-level summaries; repeats are not independent quality samples
memory: total resident plus generation peak allocated/reserved; no caching reset between warmed calls
